name: @sdkwork/birdcoder2-pad
description: BirdCoder2 tablet-first application root for iPadOS and Android tablets.

scripts.dev:standalone: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action dev --runtime-target tablet-ipados --deployment-profile standalone --environment development
scripts.dev:cloud: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action dev --runtime-target tablet-ipados --deployment-profile cloud --environment development
scripts.dev:tablet-ipados: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action dev --runtime-target tablet-ipados --deployment-profile standalone --environment development
scripts.dev:tablet-ipados:standalone: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action dev --runtime-target tablet-ipados --deployment-profile standalone --environment development
scripts.dev:tablet-ipados:cloud: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action dev --runtime-target tablet-ipados --deployment-profile cloud --environment development
scripts.dev:tablet-android: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action dev --runtime-target tablet-android --deployment-profile standalone --environment development
scripts.dev:tablet-android:standalone: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action dev --runtime-target tablet-android --deployment-profile standalone --environment development
scripts.dev:tablet-android:cloud: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action dev --runtime-target tablet-android --deployment-profile cloud --environment development
scripts.build:tablet-ipados: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action build --runtime-target tablet-ipados --deployment-profile standalone --environment production
scripts.build:tablet-ipados:prod: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action build --runtime-target tablet-ipados --deployment-profile standalone --environment production --release
scripts.build:tablet-android: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action build --runtime-target tablet-android --deployment-profile standalone --environment production
scripts.build:tablet-android:prod: node scripts/tablet.mjs --action build --runtime-target tablet-android --deployment-profile standalone --environment production --release
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:manifest && pnpm check:apps-index && pnpm check:tablet-adaptation && pnpm check:host-packages && pnpm check:assets && pnpm check:vite-aliases
